title.narrative: UNFPA humanitarian action Afghanistan and neighbouring countries 2022-2023

description.narrative:
Securing that 3.3 million women and girls will have better access to universal reproductive health care and protection services. In the long term, the country will be able to sustain the downward trend in its maternal mortality ratio.
Meeting the objectives and needs identified in the UNFPA 2022 updated Humanitarian Response Plan for Afghanistan and health and protection needs identified in the regional refugee preparedness and response plan. DKK 19 million will be granted to the UNFPA Afghanistan.
Due to its nature as a response to a humanitarian appeal operational results are general and highly aggregated and the MFA contribution is thus reflected in the overall results reporting by the partner. Please refer to the hyperlink below.
